tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: the lit LCD screen, now a fresh lime (Ecrã) or deep forest at night (Noite). Always with the dot-matrix texture.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and posts sitting on `surface`. Depth is a lighter layer of the screen, never a blur shadow.

tokens.name: surface-high
tokens.usage: Hover rows, selected options, the HUD bar and anything lifted above `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Input wells, bar tracks and the space behind illustrations; text on it uses `ink`.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips and one bold feature block per screen; text on it uses `on-inverse`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on every `surface-*` and every `*-tint`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints and metadata on every `surface-*`.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of fields and controls that must be seen (3:1 on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-high`).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Sprite green (the ship in the logo): primary buttons, correct answers, active tab, as a fill. Text on it is `on-brand`.

tokens.name: brand-edge
tokens.usage: The thick bottom edge and outline of primary buttons and bars.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of `brand` surfaces; text on it stays `on-brand`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `brand` and `brand-hover`.

tokens.name: phosphor
tokens.usage: Green AS text, icon, bracket or bar fill on any surface: links, active tab, XP bar, correct-answer text.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected and correct states, success tags, the student's own messages; text on it is `ink` or `phosphor`.

tokens.name: tiro
tokens.usage: SOL: the shot, XP, streak, rank 1, rewards and applause, as a fill. The warm spark of the screen. Text on it is `on-tiro`.

tokens.name: tiro-edge
tokens.usage: Bottom edge and outline of `tiro` buttons and medals.

tokens.name: on-tiro
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `tiro` fills.

tokens.name: tiro-ink
tokens.usage: Amber AS text, icon or bar fill (XP numbers, streak counts, warnings) on every `surface-*` and `tiro-tint`.

tokens.name: tiro-tint
tokens.usage: Reward panels and warning tags; text on it is `tiro-ink` or `ink`.

tokens.name: alvo
tokens.usage: The enemy, a hot coral: weak topics, wrong answers, blocking errors, as a fill. Text on it is `on-alvo`. Never used for people.

tokens.name: alvo-edge
tokens.usage: Bottom edge and outline of `alvo` buttons and targets.

tokens.name: on-alvo
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `alvo` fills.

tokens.name: alvo-ink
tokens.usage: Coral AS text, icon or bar fill (errors, weak topics) on every `surface-*` and `alvo-tint`.

tokens.name: alvo-tint
tokens.usage: Wrong-answer and error panels; text on it is `alvo-ink` or `ink`.

tokens.name: radar
tokens.usage: The AI tutor and system notices, a bright sky blue, as a fill (its avatar, active chip). Text on it is `on-radar`.

tokens.name: on-radar
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `radar` fills.

tokens.name: radar-ink
tokens.usage: Sky AS text or icon for the tutor's name, sources and notices on every `surface-*` and `radar-tint`.

tokens.name: radar-tint
tokens.usage: Tutor message blocks and info panels; text on it is `ink` or `radar-ink`.

tokens.name: pop
tokens.usage: Social energy: applause burst, reactions, follows, mentions and the 'new' dot, as a fill. Text on it is `on-pop`.

tokens.name: pop-edge
tokens.usage: Bottom edge and outline of `pop` chips.

tokens.name: on-pop
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `pop` fills.

tokens.name: pop-ink
tokens.usage: Pink AS text or icon (reacted state, mentions) on every `surface-*` and `pop-tint`.

tokens.name: pop-tint
tokens.usage: Reacted and mention panels; text on it is `pop-ink` or `ink`.

tokens.name: lila
tokens.usage: Subject colour and avatar variety (Matemática, Programação), as a fill. Text on it is `on-lila`.

tokens.name: lila-edge
tokens.usage: Bottom edge and outline of `lila` chips.

tokens.name: on-lila
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `lila` fills.

tokens.name: lila-ink
tokens.usage: Violet AS text or icon on every `surface-*` and `lila-tint`.

tokens.name: lila-tint
tokens.usage: Subject tags and soft panels; text on it is `lila-ink` or `ink`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid with a 3px gap; 3:1 or better on every surface it lands on.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One hero moment per screen (onboarding, results, level up). Never for paragraphs.

styles.name: hud
styles.usage: HUD numbers and labels: XP, level, streak, rank, score. Upper case or digits only.

styles.name: hud-sm
styles.usage: Small HUD labels and tags (10px is the minimum for the pixel face; it is drawn on an 8px grid and reads like 13px text). Upper case.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Grades and big metrics in tiles and results.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Exam statements and long explanations while studying.
styles.sample: Qual é o endereço de rede de 192.168.10.77/26?

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Escolhe a prova e começa a simulação.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis in body copy, names in lists.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button text, field labels, tabs, chips (sentence case).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, @statement keys, sources and file names.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: One pixel step; icon-to-text gaps; the 3D button edge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (y), list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; screen side gutters on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; control padding (x).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large sections; desktop gutters.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero and empty-state rhythm.

radius.note: Two shapes: stepped pixel corners (4px notch) for game objects, and soft radii for reading surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Bar segments, pixel icons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Fields, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Reading panels, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and large feature panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatars and filter chips.

shadow.note: No glow and no blur: a handheld screen has none. Depth is a lighter layer, the 4px edge and hard pixel offsets.

tokens.name: shadow-pixel
tokens.usage: Hard pixel offset under the hero object of a screen (the ship, a reward).

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: bottom sheets, menus, toasts.
